label_descriptions.empty-input: Calling groupBy on an empty array returns an empty object (or equivalent — no enumerable own keys). The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising empty input.
label_descriptions.single-group: All items produce different keys; each item ends up in its own single-element group. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising the every-item-distinct case.
label_descriptions.multiple-groups: Items split across multiple non-singleton groups. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising a typical multi-group case.
label_descriptions.preserves-order: Within each group, items appear in the same order they appeared in the input. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion that order within a group is preserved.
label_descriptions.numeric-keys: The keyFn returns numbers (or numbers convertible to keys). Resulting object keys may be string-coerced; the test should still find groups under those keys. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising numeric-keyed grouping.
label_descriptions.boolean-keys: The keyFn returns booleans (true/false). The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising boolean-keyed grouping.
label_descriptions.all-same-key: Every item produces the same key; all items end up in one group. The agent's tests should include at least one assertion exercising the everything-coalesces case.
